## Reality Gate

- [ ] Capability state is reported truthfully.
- [ ] No client-controlled authorization elevation.
- [ ] No fabricated success/health/risk/progress/evidence state.
- [ ] Failure and empty results are distinguishable.
- [ ] Negative paths are tested.
- [ ] DB persistence and evidence lineage are verified where applicable.
- [ ] Current-branch E2E proof exists for any completion claim.
- [ ] Generated artifacts are not source-of-truth.
- [ ] Canonical platform path is preserved.

A capability must not be labeled `Completed` without the required proof level.
